# Intent
Refine the approved Optical Reach homepage hero while ensuring every depicted product output is truthful and traceable to a real Strale contract.
# Mode and connectivity
Full design session. Git and handoff access succeeded. Notion access succeeded. No `DESIGN_ROUTER.yaml` exists in the repository, so the approved redesign artifacts in the isolated branch were used as the design canon.
# Work completed
- Audited `POST /v1/do` success and failure envelopes, SDK types, the `swedish-company-data` executor, and its manifest.
- Rejected the generated recent-funding example because it does not map to one stable shipped capability.
- Selected the documented Spotify AB known-answer fixture at organisation number 556703-7485.
- Classified contract-owned, canonical-snapshot, fixture, live-only, and unsupported fields.
- Generated separate desktop and mobile atmosphere assets with no UI, text, logo, or factual elements.
- Reconstructed the hero in responsive HTML/CSS using the approved logo, palette, Instrument Sans, IBM Plex Mono, and real product fields.
- Rendered and visually inspected desktop and mobile keyframes.
# Decision
<mention-page url="https://app.notion.com/p/3c267c87082c81e09187de8e0cd7fe46"/>
# Evidence
The proof uses the documented 5-cent `swedish-company-data` capability, Spotify AB fixture values, Bolagsverket provenance, and the real successful result field names. Transaction identifiers, latency, wallet balance, and fetched-at values are omitted from the static composition.
# Artifacts
- `docs/website-redesign/homepage/refined-hero-v1.2.md`
- `docs/website-redesign/homepage/round-03-refined-hero/refined-hero.html`
- desktop and mobile keyframes
- versioned truth fixture and image-generation record
# Boundaries
Design work remains isolated on `codex/website-redesign`. No backend code was changed. No website implementation, push, merge, or deployment occurred.
# Next recommendation
Use the approved hero truth policy as the standard for every later product screenshot, use-case visual, metric, and motion sequence. Continue with the next homepage section only after Petter reviews this refinement.
